name: Culvert Key
desc: A heavy iron key on a loop of wire, tagged GRATE No. 1.

name: Gallery Key
desc: Brass gone green with damp. The tag says CISTERN, WEST GALLERY.

name: Undergate Key
desc: A key as long as your forearm, for the last door before the source.

name: Lockkeeper's Charges
desc: Two blasting charges in an oilcloth bag, left over from when the locks were built. Enough to bring down a roof, or a wall.

name: A Single Charge
desc: One blasting charge, half of a pair. Not enough for a roof. Not enough for a wall. Enough to make someone else's plan work.

name: Pumphouse Ledger
desc: Teo's contract in his tidy hand: one god, to turn the turbines of the Ward, in perpetuity. A space at the bottom for a signature.

name: Sallow Stone
desc: A river-smoothed boundary marker with SALLOW cut into it. Hester says it remembers where the river used to run.

name: Stamped Wrench
desc: A pipe wrench that was jammed in the Undergate winch. Stamped into the handle: PUMPHOUSE, T. MARCHETTI.
